documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported a 20% increase in standalone revenue and a 25% increase in consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27, driven mainly by product mix and export growth. Management noted volatility in raw material and freight costs while maintaining an expected top-line growth of 10% to 15% over the coming years. The company is currently utilizing around 75% to 78% of its PVC capacity and plans to add an additional production line by the end of the financial year. International expansions and plant locations are still under evaluation due to ongoing market volatility. Mayur Uniquoters reported robust financial results for Q4 and FY26, driven by a growing export mix and higher automotive segment contributions.

guidance.claim: The company targets an average growth of 15% in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Value is expected to grow by 15% on average for the next 2 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The footwear business experienced a muted market and degrowth due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter. So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management views India's recent FTA as a positive move that will improve European customer sentiments towards procuring from India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the PU business remains muted at present with commercial settlements yet to mature.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the European automotive industry is not growing and is experiencing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new line for its current premises to add an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters with production expected to start by February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that if a final call on putting up a new facility is taken, the capex in the next 2 years will be around INR250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: if we have taken a final call on putting up a new facility somewhere. So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new coating line to be set up within an existing facility rather than South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex for a potential global location would be around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion currently discussed is for a PVC plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes. Whatever you're talking about expansion right now is about the PVC plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable margins are expected to be 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased due to a 4x rise in export shipping costs alongside traveling, legal, and professional service costs.
margins_costs.quote: No, it's mixed reasons. Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC increased significantly initially, but availability is no longer an issue and prices have softened.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization of PVC is running between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed PVC monthly capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported total sales volume of 31 million meters for the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted market volatility due to factors like Trump tariffs, the West Asia war, and shifting raw material and freight prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU plant is facing intense competition from China and underutilizing capacity.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure. So, there are 2 options. Obviously, I've told in the past also that we are talking to top brands, but sampling is also been done, but no business has been confirmed so far.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that it is very difficult to predict raw material prices given external uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, it's very difficult to predict the prices. Definitely, because things are settled right now. So, we don't see any increase in the near future as of today. It's very difficult to predict what Trump does tomorrow.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line in the current premises is expected to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The newly ordered coating line is expected to be completed by the end of the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a 15% growth outlook for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

management_commitments.claim: Once a decision is taken for the South plant, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
management_commitments.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
